data.name: Bhagvant
data.gender_notes: Bhagvant is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Bhagvant is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘bhag’ meaning fortune, happiness, or god and ‘vant’ meaning carrier or possessor. Thus, Bhagvant can be translated as ‘the one who carries or possesses god.’ This name is often given to a child who is believed to be blessed by the gods or to invoke divine protection and blessings.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes devotion, faith, and surrender to the divine.
data.etymology: Bhagvant belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord, God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhagvant total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
